subject.title: [AI] fix(agents): recover from non-resumable assistant tail by re-presenting last user message

question: When a restart leaves a text-only assistant tail, should OpenClaw silently run the original request again, require explicit confirmation, or retain the current resend notice?
rationale: The transcript tail alone cannot prove whether earlier side effects in the interrupted turn committed, so source inspection cannot safely choose the replay policy without owner intent.

options.title: Recover with confirmation
options.body: Re-present the original request and require explicit confirmation whenever committed side effects cannot be ruled out.

options.title: Allow silent replay
options.body: Auto-resume text-only assistant tails and explicitly accept possible repeated work, backed by stronger state classification and live replay proof.

options.title: Keep fail-closed behavior
options.body: Retain the documented resend notice until durable run state can distinguish completed, partial, and undelivered-final turns.

recommendation.title: Recover with confirmation
recommendation.body: Re-present the original request and require explicit confirmation whenever committed side effects cannot be ruled out.

likelyOwner.reason: The foundational graceful-restart recovery work is assigned to this person and the choice governs that feature's safety semantics.
